Exor's disposals of its holdings, such as Ferrari and Iveco, are not events of Exor itself and are excluded. The is_subsidiary answer reflects majority control (about 57% per Wikipedia) by the private Giovanni Agnelli B.V., not full ownership. This is a judgement call, so treat it with care.
